sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – two-year full-volume proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we agree to your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1), DAP. On commitment, your capacity letter (doc:20260918-70410-P10) states that you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, for 24 months.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit. Payment would be 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm – two-year full-volume proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year and accept these terms alongside the 54-day lead time. However, your price expectation is unrealistic and does not reflect our manufacturing realities. We can offer EUR 31.70 per unit under these conditions. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Complete three-year package for the 24 mm mechanical seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for accepting the full 23,400 pcs per year with the 54-day lead time. We understand your view on manufacturing realities and want to meet you on a complete package.

We move from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.00/unit and add a third committed year: 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year, for 36 months. We continue to accept 54 days instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1), DAP. Payment remains 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

Our March annual-review note records that price changes above 2% required pricing-committee approval (doc:20260310-70410-M1). Please present this complete three-year package to the pricing committee for approval at EUR 31.00, with you remaining our lead. If that process has changed, please confirm who can approve this complete package.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Complete three-year package for the 24 mm mechanical seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

In exchange for the 36-month commitment, we adjust our price to EUR 31.40 per unit. Our offer contains a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please provide the March annual-review note you referenced, as it is not in our records.

I confirm that I am authorized to approve this package directly. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
